story.title: Some things deserve a little more time.
story.text: The best part of a food truck is the moment a neighborhood becomes a table. Our sample menu keeps the choices focused and the flavors generous.

guide.title: Different corners. Same good food.
guide.intro: A sample week on the road. These fictional locations show how a truck can keep its neighborhood in the loop.

notes.title: Thursday · 11:30–2:00
notes.text: Lunch at Foundry Courtyard. A quick menu for the midday crowd, with vegetarian options and salsa on the side.

notes.title: Friday · 5:00–8:30
notes.text: Evening at Riverbend Market. Grab a trio, settle into the shared seating, and make a night of it.

notes.title: Saturday · 12:00–4:00
notes.text: A slow afternoon at Cedar Park Commons. Family-friendly service and a rotating seasonal agua fresca.

notes.title: Bring us to your people
notes.text: For an office lunch, backyard gathering, or celebration, tell us your date, guest count, and preferred menu. The event planner turns those details into a sample brief.

faq.a: The sample menu includes a plant-based option. A real event inquiry would confirm ingredients, allergies, and shared-surface considerations before the menu is finalized.

faq.q: Can I place a real order here?
faq.a: This is an interactive website example. Menu prices, stops, and event requests are illustrative; no food orders or payments are accepted.

faq.q: What does a private event need?
faq.a: A proposed date, head count, service window, and room for the truck. The business would confirm access, setup, minimums, and final availability directly.
